rows.note: This is the all-purpose way to express “provided that A, B” in everyday Cantonese.

example.english: You won't be late, provided you get up early.
example.traditional: 只要你肯早啲起身，就唔會遲到。
example.jyutping: zi2 jiu3 nei5 hang2 zou2 di1 hei2 san1 zau6 m4 wui5 ci4 dou3

rows.note: Use this when stressing that B is possible only after the required condition A is met.

example.english: You can collect the goods, provided you sign for them.
example.jyutping: jiu3 nei5 cim1 sau1 sin1 ho2 ji5 lo2 fo3
